content: The Prototipo RS - **Red/Black/Orange** model offers all-day comfort with additional padding on the tongue, heel, and collar. It features an **ONSTEAM anti-microbial lining** for moisture and odor control and a **removable, contoured cork & EVA foam insole** with a perforated footbed.
